summary: Iter-55 fully verified: (1) Distractor stats — insights modal shows per-option distribution bars with TOP DISTRACTOR badge on the most-picked wrong option and green ✓ on the correct option (e.g. Q13: ✓ ATP-PC (phosphagen) correct, Glycolytic flagged TOP DISTRACTOR). (2) CSV export — /api/exams/4/question-insights.csv returns 200 text/csv with the exact header and 5 data rows for admin, 403 for learner; UI 'Export CSV' button downloads file 'question-insights-exam-4.csv'. (3) Miss-rate alert — deliberate learner fail (Q1-Q3 wrong, Q4-Q5 correct) submitted with score 40% pushed Q13-Q15 to 67% miss (≥50% & 3 answers). Backend fired QUESTION_MISS_ALERT notifications ('⚠️ 67% miss rate on "Foundations of Exercise Science Assessment"') and queued question_miss_alert emails to org managers in /api/admin/outbox (subject '⚠️ Question needs attention on Foundations of Exercise Science Assessment', template=question_miss_alert, transport=stub, status=QUEUED). Insights UI shows 'author alerted' chip on alerted questions. Re-arm confirmed: PATCH q13 explanation clears miss_alerted_at (chip disappears). All 5 pytest tests PASS, no console errors, Learners tab regression OK.

distractor_stats_ui.evidence: distractor-stats-13 renders 3 rows: Glycolytic 1(33%) TOP DISTRACTOR, ✓ ATP-PC (phosphagen) 1(33%), Oxidative (aerobic) 1(33%). top-distractor-13 badge text='TOP DISTRACTOR'. Q2 shows 'Training to failure every session' TOP DISTRACTOR; Q3 'During the workout'; Q4 'Frequency'.

csv_export_backend.evidence: GET /api/exams/4/question-insights.csv (admin) → 200, content-type text/csv, header exactly ['#','question','type','points','answered','correct','missed','miss_rate_pct','top_wrong_answer','top_wrong_count','correct_answer'], 5 data rows. Sample row: [1, 'Which energy system dominates a maximal 8-second sprint?', MULTIPLE_CHOICE, 1, 3, 1, 2, 67, Glycolytic, 1, ATP-PC (phosphagen)]. Learner token → 403.

miss_alert_notifications.evidence: GET /api/notifications returns 3 QUESTION_MISS_ALERT notifs titled '⚠️ 67% miss rate on "Foundations of Exercise Science Assessment"'.

miss_alert_outbox.evidence: GET /api/admin/outbox → newest messages are template=question_miss_alert, subject='⚠️ Question needs attention on Foundations of Exercise Science Assessment', status=QUEUED, transport=stub. Sent to multiple org managers (qa-admin, admin, several instructors).

author_alerted_chip.evidence: 'author alerted' chip renders on Q14 and Q15 insight rows (Q13's cleared after re-arm PATCH). 2 occurrences visible on screen.

re_arm_on_edit.evidence: PATCH /api/exams/4/questions/13 with explanation change → 200. Subsequent GET question-insights shows Q13 miss_alerted_at=null while Q14/Q15 remain '2026-08-07T05:45:44...'. UI 'author alerted' chip on Q13 gone.

regression_learners_tab.evidence: Test Learner shown as 3/3 attempts, best 100%, Status Passed (deliberate fail did not lock out — learner already had a passing attempt). Reset button present.

console_errors.evidence: No page errors during login → exams → attempts → insights → CSV download flow.

critical_code_review_comments: In routers/exams.py the CSV endpoint reuses exam_question_insights() and writes bytes with default csv writer — non-ASCII correct_answer/question_text values will still work, but consider adding response encoding=utf-8 in Content-Type for clarity (currently 'text/csv' without charset).
GET /api/admin/outbox returns 'messages' key while other list endpoints in the codebase use 'items'/'results' — inconsistency slightly complicates client generalisation.
seed_data_creation: Consumed learner's 3rd attempt on exam 4 (score 40, failed) which fired miss alerts for Q13-Q15. Then edited Q13 explanation (appended ' (reviewed)') which re-armed Q13 (miss_alerted_at cleared). Exam 4 total_attempts now = 3, learner best still 100% Passed (from earlier passing attempt). 3 QUESTION_MISS_ALERT notifications and ~20 question_miss_alert outbox rows persisted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter-55 fully verified. State: exam 4 has 3 attempts, learner at 3/3 (best 100%, Passed). Q13 explanation was extended with ' (reviewed)' twice (now '(reviewed) (reviewed) (reviewed)' — from repeated re-arm tests). Q14 & Q15 still have miss_alerted_at set (not re-armed). Q17 still has ' (tf-check)' explanation appended from iter-54. Learner can NO LONGER submit new attempts on exam 4 (max=3 reached) — if a future test needs a fresh fail, use the admin Reset button first. Outbox contains 20+ question_miss_alert messages (QUEUED, stub transport).
